name: 矩媒 MatrixMedia
description: Publish videos to Douyin, Kuaishou, WeChat Channels, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, Baijiahao, Toutiao and Fanqie via the MatrixMedia desktop app.
description_zh: 通过本机矩媒桌面端，用自然语言把视频一键发布到抖音、快手、视频号、小红书、B站、百家号、头条、番茄视频，并查询账号登录态、发布记录与粉丝数据。需先安装矩媒桌面端。
description_en: Publish videos to 8 Chinese short-video platforms, check login status, publish history and account stats through the locally installed MatrixMedia desktop app.
examples_zh: 把桌面上的 demo.mp4 发到抖音账号 13800138000，标题是“新手跑步第一天”
看看我哪些账号登录过期了
把这个视频同时发到视频号和小红书，今晚 8 点定时发布
查一下最近 7 天发布失败的记录
同步一下抖音账号的粉丝和播放数据
examples_en: Publish ~/Desktop/demo.mp4 to Douyin account 13800138000 with title "Day one running"
Which of my accounts have expired logins?
Schedule this video to WeChat Channels and Xiaohongshu at 8pm tonight
